candidate.role: harness process and executable-composition test owner

synthetic_downstream.role: bounded game-mod HTTP endpoint; it never replaces gateway, MCP, or harness implementations

coordinated_candidate_pair.requirement: workflow_dispatch may replace either immutable peer only with an explicit full 40-hex revision. Both supplied revisions are recorded by the workflow and must be reviewed before pin promotion.
coordinated_candidate_pair.pin_update_rule: Do not update a default pin from a moving branch or a dirty working tree. Promote only exact revisions after the positive and negative executable cases pass.
